subject: Simplify dictType callbacks and move some macros from dict.h to dict.c (#1281)
reason: Pure mechanical refactor: the change removes the unused `dict *d` parameter from the dictType keyDup/keyCompare/keyDestructor/valDestructor callbacks and updates all implementations and call sites; every affected callback previously began with UNUSED(d), so none ever used the parameter. The dictFreeKey/dictFreeVal macros moved from dict.h into dict.c as static functions used nowhere else, and dictCompareKeys became a static inline with identical logic.
